name: BXP, Inc.
summary: BXP, Inc. is the largest publicly traded developer, owner, and manager of premier workplaces in the United States. It is concentrated in six dynamic gateway markets - Boston, Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, and Washington, DC. BXP has delivered places that power progress for our clients and communities for more than 55 years. BXP is a fully integrated real estate company, organized as a real estate investment trust (REIT). As of June 30, 2026, including properties owned by joint ventures, BXP's portfolio totals 50.6 million square feet and 162 properties, including six properties under construction/redevelopment.
